name: Settling Capacity 1 Code
definition: Specifies the role of the party in the settlement of the transaction.

CUST.name: Settling Custodian
CUST.definition: Settlement party is a custodian. It receives/delivers the securities and carries out custodial duties.

SAGE.name: Settling Agent
SAGE.definition: Settlement party is trading and settling transactions in financial instruments on behalf of its client(s).

SPRI.name: Settling Principal
SPRI.definition: Settlement party is settling its own trades.
